question: Which team won the Indian Super League (ISL) 2024-25 title?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Mohun Bagan Super Giant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mohun Bagan Super Giant clinches Indian Super League 2024-25 title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

 
• 
 
Mohun Bagan Super Giant won the **ISL 2024-25** title.

 
 
• 
 
They beat **Bengaluru FC 2-1** in the final.

 
 
• 
 
The match was held at **Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan Stadium**, Kolkata.

 
 
• 
 
This was **Mohun Bagan’s second ISL title** (first was in **2022-23**).

 
 
• 
 
They became only the **second team** to win both:

 
 
• 
 
**League Winners Shield** and

 
 
• 
 
**ISL Cup** in the **same season**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The first team to do this was **Mumbai City FC** in **2020-21**.
